problem: The project export manifest is authorized with read access on the server, but the Projects actions menu exposed export only to write-capable roles.
root_cause: Frontend placed the read-only export action inside the canManageProject branch.

change.behavior: Shared viewer members now see and can invoke the bounded provenance export; write-only lifecycle and metadata actions remain hidden.

new_findings: CO-029 remains the next P0 authorization candidate: cross-project/cross-user fuzzing across exact routes.
